messages:
Alex: Spike idea 1: add a 'Compare invoices' panel so users can open two invoices side-by-side and see token deltas per model/project. Mock: https://img.redwood/mock/invoice-compare.png
Priya: Love it for audits. Quick UX Q: do we show absolute token diffs or percentage deltas? Both could be useful.
Diego: Both. Primary column absolute (e.g., +1,234 tokens) and a secondary % column. Keep compact numbers (2.3k) with exact in tooltip/aria-label.
Zoe: Export concern: CSV should include compare_left_id, compare_right_id, units_type, and a delta column. Prefer server-side compare endpoint so exports are deterministic: `/invoices/compare?left=123&right=456&units=tokens&expand=true`
Alex: Agreed. Server-side is necessary. Also add a query param `group_by=project|model|token_type` to match UI toggles.
Priya: Accessibility: panel must be keyboard-trappable. Use role="dialog" for the pane, focus the close button on open, and when results render announce summary via aria-live: "Comparison loaded: total delta +2,345 tokens".
Diego: Perf: comparing huge invoices could be heavy. Add a debounce and cap details initially (top 50 line items), with a 'show all' button that lazy-loads the rest.
Zoe: Copy: header should read "Compare invoices" and the subcopy "Showing token delta (left → right)" so direction is clear. For org-level vs project-level, show a small badge: "Org view" or "Project view".
finance-bot: Reminder: when units!=tokens, include units conversion rate in export metadata and API response. Add `units_note` field to CSV JSON comment.
Alex: UI pattern: split pane with synced sparklines for left/right invoices, and a diff column in the middle with +/- color coding (green for decrease, red for increase). But color alone can't be the only indicator. Add icons and textual sign.
Priya: Keyboard/A11y nit: diff column should be readable by screenreaders as "increase by 1,234 tokens (54%)". Also ensure high-contrast mode has distinct icons.
Diego: Dev estimate: frontend panel + sparklines + keyboard flows ~4 dev days; server compare endpoint + CSV export ~2 days; QA + accessibility pass ~1 day.
Zoe: Acceptance criteria: server-side compare endpoint, UI pane with left/right headers, synced sparklines, delta column with absolute + percent, CSV export shape includes compare ids + units_note, aria-live announcement, cap with lazy-load and "show all".
Alex: I'll push a low-fidelity prototype and file API ticket. Assign @diego frontend, @zoe backend, @priya a11y review.
Priya: Also add audit event when a comparison is generated for compliance.
finance-bot: Note: CSV schema change needs docs and a migration note for finance consumers.
Alex: Thanks! Will drop mocks and a short demo gif once the prototype is up. :sparkles:
